english.title: Fail to queue as direct by a notice / request on the Tyne and Wear Metro
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..), on or near the Tyne and Wear Metro situated at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) when

(A)_[directed to queue by a notice]_
(B)_[asked to queue by an authorised person]_

failed to

(C)_[join the rear of the queue]_
(D)_[obey the reasonable instructions of an authorised person regulating that queue]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 1(2) and 31(1) of the Tyne and Wear Metro Byelaws made under sections 58 and 62 of the Tyneside Metropolitan Railway Act 1973.

english.notes:
(i) Byelaw 30 make provisions in relation to name and addresses.
(ii) Byelaw 31(2) provides powers for the removal of persons.
(iii) When using these powers, an authorised person, including a constable, must show his/her identification if requested.
